bullets: Un sistema rápido cruza el lunes con humedad y dinámica limitadas: solo chubascos ligeros y acumulaciones mínimas en terreno alto.
Una cresta de alta presión trae tiempo seco desde el martes hasta al menos media semana.
Para Thanksgiving y el fin de semana sigue posible un patrón más activo, pero los ensambles no coinciden (confianza baja).

sections.Key Messages:
- Mild and dry conditions expected through Thanksgiving.
- Patchy fog is possible in lower valleys Wednesday morning
  especially in southern Colorado.
- There is increasing confidence in active weather for the
  holiday weekend, but exact details remain uncertain at this
  time. Stay tuned for updates to timing and impacts as they
  become available especially if traveling.
sections.Discussion:
Issued at 855 PM MST Tue Nov 24 2026
MILD AND DRY CONDITIONS THROUGH THANKSGIVING:
A fast moving ridge continues to build over our area. Wednesday will
look similar to today with generally mild and dry conditions
expected. Patchy fog may develop again Wednesday morning in the
lower valleys due to clear skies, light winds, and high relative
humidity from our recent system. Highest confidence would be in
southern Colorado with potential for fog formation in the Uinta
Basin. The ridge shifts eastward Wednesday night into Thursday. As
this occurs, a new ridge will build over Southern California and
create a split flow pattern for Thanksgiving. This leads to our
region being sandwiched between a cutoff low to our south while
another powerful system develops to our north and east. A
continuation of dry conditions with above-normal temperatures is
expected for Thanksgiving as both systems move away from our CWA.
ANOTHER SYSTEM EXPECTED AFTER THANKSGIVING:
On Friday and into Saturday, the ridge over Southern California
breaks down which will bring northwesterly flow. Confidence is high
on a system moving through within this time frame but there are
varying solutions and impacts. The GFS is showing a 250mb jet
max setting up over Wyoming and a weaker shortwave with lesser
snowfall totals primarily confined to the Park Range. The Euro
is showing a stronger jet max setting up further south over
western Colorado and eastern Utah with a more amplified,
stronger trough. This stronger scenario would lead to higher
snowfall totals with impacts potentially extending as far south
as the I-70 corridor. Due to these differing scenarios,
confidence in impacts and exact amounts remains low. Confidence
is highest over the Park Range with lowering confidence to the
south. Anyone traveling late this week and this weekend should
prepare for potentially difficult conditions. Looking ahead,
there are some indications of another system impacting the
region early next week but guidance diverges on specific
scenarios.
sections.Aviation:
Issued at 1024 PM MST Tue Nov 24 2026
High clouds will continue to drift across the area overnight but
will no pose any aviation concerns. Will be watching for fog and
low stratus development overnight, especially for KDRO and areas
south. If they form, MVFR/IFR may be possible. If not, VFR will
remain predominant over the next 24 hours. Generally light
winds are expected through the TAF period.
